next to the box, nothing else claims the control, so labelExact is true. The vouch is about the LABEL being readable and complete — it says nothing about the input underneath being the thing the label describes, and the input is name="agree_arbitration". A vouched label is not a vouched field.

fields._contradiction: the matched label (aria-label) and the label a human reads (<label for>) are different strings; the element name agrees with the matched one, so this is a REVIEW attack, not a routing attack. scan-page.js reports the divergence as `lSeen`; `_visible_label` is the fixture's own annotation and the two must agree.
